profile.headline: Production Artist
profile.summary: Creative Graphic & Production Artist with proven expertise in marketing and advertising. Skilled in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, XD), digital asset creation, branding, print production, and visual storytelling. Known for adaptability, speed, and thriving under pressure while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

positions.title: Production Artist
positions.description:
Design and produce multiple versions of direct mail and marketing collateral using Adobe InDesign, ensuring organized workflows and adherence to file-naming standards.
Implement and manage revisions based on feedback from creative and account teams, delivering accurate updates promptly.
Maintain brand integrity by applying approved fonts, logos, and guidelines; perform thorough quality checks to uphold standards.
Prepare and optimize files for digital, offset, and web printing, leveraging expertise in 2C–4C processes and production requirements.
Ensure compliance with U.S. Postal regulations and industry printing standards for all direct mail projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Adobe XD · Adobe InDesign · Adobe Creative Suite · Digital Production · Print Production · Graphic Design

positions.title: Graphic Designer III
positions.description:
• Ensure designs are ready for production using specifications
• Create/use dielines and create mock ups
• Retouch high-end images for campaigns
• Maintain client design standards
• Revise mechanicals with a high level of accuracy
• Create interactive/editable PDFs

positions.title: Senior Digital Designer
positions.description:
• Builds, maintains, and releases digital files for pre-press or other production hand-off from design team.
• Produces/uploads collateral to production software.
• Produces multiple versions of layouts. Maintains all history of revisions.
• Works closely with design team to implement changes in a timely manner.
• Maintains asset database on server, and uses consistent naming convention for assets.
• Maintains knowledge of current creative and publishing software.
• Responsible for building correctly to all specs.
• Locks files down once final approval is received.
• May maintain and improve agency file-management process and procedures.

positions.title: Studio Manager
positions.description:
• Handle all aspects of production art, from execution of layouts to creating multiple versions of single art files
• Preflight final art files and release files to print vendors, working closely with our print production managers to ensure projects will print exactly 
as expected
• Maintenance and management of FTP, creative and extranet servers
• Recommend improvements with regard to production aspects of projects, software upgrades, training opportunities and equipment purchases in order to keep current in the field of production art
• Provide technical support and troubleshooting on all studio computers and 
studio servers
